headline: Fully funded, no debt, first copper concentrate targeted for early 2028 from high-grade Jervois copper-gold-silver project in NT, with Wheaton Precious Metals $300M streaming deal and Sedgman as EPC contractor
reasoning: KGL Resources has received the second $16M USD instalment from Wheaton Precious Metals, completing a $32M USD early deposit under a $300M precious metals purchase agreement. The Jervois project is a 10-year open pit transitioning to underground mine, producing ~30,000 tonnes of copper metal in concentrate per annum from a 2 million tonne per annum plant at 2% copper equivalent grade. The company is fully funded with no debt and a liquidity buffer above the capital required to bring the project into production. Construction begins in earnest in 2027 with open pit mining mid-year and first concentrate planned for early 2028. Exploration is also underway on the Jervois tenement to extend mine life beyond 10 years, with a drill rig currently on site.
quote: Look, I mean that that that's the other thing for a, for a junior mining company. We, we are fully funded. So with the $300 million precious metals purchase agreement with Wheaton, we also did an equity rise earlier in in August. So we have all of our funds plus a liquidity buffer to bring KGL into in into production. So we have the remainder of this year sort of getting the site ready really construction activities in earnest in 2027 Will we'll have our mining beginning halfway through the year, our open pit mining, doing our strip and getting our water up onto the ROM and then getting into production in in early 28. So we are, we are fully funded, we have no debt and we have certainly have a a sufficient liquidity buffer on top of the capital that we need to to bring this operation into into reality.
